cc:Work.dc:title: Rust spatial encoding cache throughput
cc:Work.dc:description: Full projection versus cached projection in complete Chen-core games including spatial tensor construction. Median of five runs on 2026-11-10. Single Gym environment, seeds 42 and 99: 171.3277 to 341.9052 decisions/second. Four native slots and four threads, seeds 42 to 45: 188.3140 to 517.3472. Timing covers environment and data preparation.
